title: Site changes is a vertical timeline: every row shows a chevron and toggles, and change and backup rows share one actions column edge
steps: S1: run packages/site/tracy-site-tabs/test/e2e/changes-v2.test.mjs (headless Chromium against the built Site changes bundle with a stub door).
expect: S1: chevron, title and meta line stay put when a row opens and closes; one right edge for the actions of change and backup rows in a 1440px pane; every row toggles aria-expanded; no ... button when its menu would be empty and Undo shows without hover.
fence: Row geometry and the actions column are measured in the DOM, not read from copy

tests: the actions column: one right edge for change and backup rows in a 1440px pane
every row shows a chevron before it is opened, and pressing the row toggles aria-expanded
no … button on a row whose menu would be empty; Undo is on screen without hover
